title: Second-hand Shoes Collected in Project for Recycling to Create Running Tracks Exported for Overseas Resale
what_it_is: Second-hand Shoes Collected in Project for Recycling to Create Running Tracks Exported for Overseas Resale

sections.label: Shoe recycling diversion investigation
sections.summary: In January 2023 project partners were alerted that shoes in recycling bins were diverted for resale, and an investigation began.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In January 2023, the project partners were alerted about Reuter's observations that shoes put into recycling bins in Singapore and intended for the shoe recycling project were being diverted for resale.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: An investigation was immediately commenced by the project partners to look into these observations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Alba-WH, as the party responsible for the collection of the shoe recycling bins, had engaged Yok Impex, another company, to do so for selected parts of Singapore.

sections.label: Investigation findings and contract termination
sections.summary: The investigation found shoes at Yok Impex's premises were not properly segregated and were exported for resale; Alba-WH terminated Yok Impex's services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The investigation found that the shoe recycling bins at Yok Impex's premises were not properly segregated from other sorting activities, resulting in some shoes which were meant for recycling being exported to other countries for resale.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Alba-WH has since terminated the services of Yok Impex.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The project partners have also taken steps to tighten the process chain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: These steps include appointing only contractors and subcontractors that are not involved in any second-hand trading of textiles or shoes.

sections.label: Recycled shoes in sport infrastructure
sections.summary: Ten thousand kilogrammes of shoes have been processed and used in sport infrastructure, with remaining granules planned for Sport Centres and other facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Ten thousand kilogrammes of shoes have been processed and used in sport infrastructure, such as the running track at the Kallang Football Hub that has already been installed and an 888-metre jogging trail currently under construction in Jurong Town.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The remaining recycled granules are planned for use at our Sport Centres, such as in Serangoon, Bukit Canberra and Punggol, as well as other jogging tracks, fitness centres and also playgrounds around Singapore.
